# The rpengine:proxy messages, version 2, as bytes (hex).
#
# RP Engine and RPE Proxy each keep their own code for these messages, so this
# file is the same in both projects and each one's ProxyWireTest encodes and
# decodes every line of it. Change the format: bump the version in both, write
# the new bytes here, and copy the file to the other project.
#
# Pack ids are 00000000-0000-0001-0000-000000000002 and
# 00000000-0000-0003-0000-000000000004; a, b and c are those letters 40 times.

#         (id 2, sha1 c, source c, no url, 5678 bytes)
# need:   sha1 c
# chunk:  sha1 c, chunk 1 of 3, bytes 01 02 03
# status: id 1, SUCCESSFULLY_LOADED
